convention: T_body_reference: p_body=R_body_reference @ p_reference+t_body_reference. Reference must be the actual Point-LIO odometry child reference, possibly lidar IMU, not guessed from its name.
body_axes: x forward, y left, z up; lengths in metres, rotations in radians
note: Fill from measured hardware. geometry_boxes are collision envelopes. Only actual solid measured parts belong in self_filter_boxes; never use the hollow head-frame envelope as a solid self filter. True flags are operator declarations, not automatic hardware acceptance.
